title: Fireworks Festival (DS)
wikitext:
The '''Fireworks Festival''' is an event on the 24th day of Summer in ''[[Harvest Moon DS]]'' and ''[[Harvest Moon DS: Cute]]''.
[[File:Fireworks DS.png|thumb]]
To participate in the festival, walk down to the beach between 6pm and 9pm. All of the eligible bachelorettes (or bachelors in the girl version) will be there. If any of them are at a Green Heart or higher, then you have the option to invite them to watch the fireworks with you. If none of them have reached green heart yet, then you will watch the show with Kassey and Patrick. If you are married, then you can view the fireworks with your spouse.<ref>[http://fogu.com/hm6/chan6/festivals_summer.php Harvest Moon: DS Summer Festivals] ''fogu.com''</ref>
